body: Dame opens up about his time with the Milwaukee Bucks, playing alongside Giannis Antetokounmpo, and the mental challenges of recovering from an Achilles injury. He also shares his excitement about the Trail Blazers' future, what he's learned about new teammate Ja Morant, and how he made over 100,000 shots during his recovery.

PLUS, Chiney and Dame go to the tape to break down some of the most unforgettable moments in NBA history! From his legendary playoff buzzer-beaters against the Rockets and Thunder to his incredible 71-point performance, Dame reveals the preparation, decisions, and mindset behind the moments that made him one of the NBA's most clutch players.

articles.title: Kiah Stokes Takes Over! Golden State Beats Atlanta in Game 5 of WNBA Finals | Chiney Today
articles.summary: The Golden State Valkyries are officially one win away from making history and winning a WNBA Championship! 🏆🔥
body: After defeating the Atlanta Dream 64-55 in Game 5 of the Finals, with help from Kiah Stokes and Veronica Burton, the Valkyries have taken control of the series. But can Angel Reese and Atlanta bounce back to force a Game 7?

Chiney Ogwumike is joined by special guest DJ Tricey Trice to break down Golden State's dominant defensive performance, Kiah Stokes' incredible impact on both ends of the floor, and the coaching adjustments that have Natalie Nakase's Valkyries on the verge of their first title.

Plus, could a defensive specialist like Kiah Stokes actually win Finals MVP? Has Golden State finally figured out how to neutralize Angel Reese? And Chiney and DJ disagree on which team will ultimately win it all!
